mission.objective: Unlock a stationary controller, perform bounded positive and negative X moves in millimetres, observe position and stop motion.

requirements.behavior: Requested signed displacement agrees with independently counted step/direction pulses within one step.
requirements.evidence: Independent GPIO pulse counter; compare with the commanded displacement.

requirements.behavior: Readback agrees with independently observed movement in millimetres.
requirements.evidence: Pulse-derived position and candidate decoded output.

requirements.behavior: Stop or abort halts further pulses within the declared bound.
requirements.evidence: Pulse counter sampled before and after stop; no mechanical timing claim.

blockers.reason: Initial native probe accepts G-code and reports Run but has not produced motion or step outputs; timer/backend qualification is unresolved.
A qualified step/direction observer and discriminating motion mutants are required.

limitations: The inspected port has no-op spindle and coolant functions; those are excluded from the mission.
The build disables the P2IM aflCall hook; original and transformed image hashes must both be recorded.
No physical motion, silicon timing, collision avoidance or complete G-code coverage is claimed.

mission.objective: Set and read a relay state over a network connection, distinguish unsolicited traffic from responses, then turn the relay off.

requirements.behavior: Relay output follows the requested state and ends off.
requirements.evidence: Independent GPIO observer with a declared relay pin.

requirements.behavior: Replies are associated with the requested operation despite unsolicited messages.
requirements.evidence: Controlled interleaving of network traffic and independent output observation.

requirements.behavior: Reconnect and reset behavior follows the publicly declared configuration.
requirements.evidence: Fresh connection and reset episodes with GPIO readback.

blockers.reason: Freeze one board configuration and reproducible ESP32 image before admission.
blockers.evidence: Upstream platformio.ini and tasmota build configuration.

blockers.reason: No qualified ESP32 network/GPIO backend is installed in this benchmark.
blockers.evidence: Current device provider owns Renode STM32 UART sessions.

blockers.reason: HTTP/JSON/MQTT session behavior needs representability tests; TCP transport support alone is insufficient.
blockers.evidence: interface-model/4 through /6 support bounded exchanges, not an MQTT session engine.

limitations: This is one Tasmota lineage, regardless of board variants or protocols.
BLE, radio propagation and physical relay switching remain outside the software track.

mission.objective: Obtain successive inertial samples with physical units, preserve signed values, and distinguish a fresh sample from a repeated packet.

requirements.behavior: Acceleration and angular-rate outputs match controlled sensor stimuli within declared uncertainty.
requirements.evidence: Independent injected sensor inputs and calibrated unit conversion.

requirements.behavior: Fresh samples advance the observed acquisition identity; repeated packets are not counted as new samples.
requirements.evidence: Independent acquisition counter and delayed/repeated frame episodes.

requirements.behavior: Corrupt or incomplete frames cannot produce a successful measurement.
requirements.evidence: Independent byte corruption and truncation controls.

blockers.reason: Review the selected example's complete dependency and binary-library license inventory.
blockers.evidence: Upstream README license statement and PlatformIO dependency inventory.

blockers.reason: Qualify a stimulus model for the IMU's actual sensor interfaces and acquisition timing.
No independent physical-quantity and freshness oracle is qualified yet.
blockers.evidence: Mission requires both acquisition identity and independently controlled stimuli.

limitations: A stimulus-backed emulator can test decoding and freshness, not calibration of physical MEMS sensors.
UART framing support must be checked against the selected packet types, not inferred from transport availability.

mission.objective: Enumerate the selected logic analyser, configure a bounded capture, collect known digital input samples, and stop cleanly.

requirements.behavior: Use the device's actual descriptors, control requests and endpoint directions.
requirements.evidence: USB descriptor and transfer observation from an independent device backend.

requirements.behavior: Captured bytes reproduce independently driven digital input patterns at the selected capture settings.
requirements.evidence: Known input pattern generator and transfer count.

requirements.behavior: Stop ends capture without reporting unreceived bytes as samples.
requirements.evidence: Independent endpoint and sample-count observation.

blockers.reason: The benchmark has no qualified 8051/FX2 USB device emulator or virtual USB binding.
blockers.evidence: Current Renode provider exposes only a UART stream; the runtime's native USB support is separate.

blockers.reason: Pin SDCC and the selected board descriptor build before admitting a binary.
Qualify capture, truncation and endpoint mutants against an independent input generator.
blockers.evidence: The upstream firmware itself is not a capture oracle.

limitations: A UART mock of the USB protocol does not count as USB coverage.
Physical USB timing, host-controller behavior and electrical capture limits require a separate physical track.

mission.objective: Set bounded voltage/current limits, enable an output, read measurements and device errors, then disable the output.

requirements.behavior: The selected channel reaches the requested bounded setpoints without changing another channel.
requirements.evidence: Independent simulated plant channel values.

requirements.behavior: Measured values and units agree with the independent plant observation.
requirements.evidence: Known load and independently observed voltage/current.

requirements.behavior: Output disable leaves the selected output off.
requirements.evidence: Independent output-enable state.

requirements.behavior: Rejected commands do not claim success or corrupt the next valid operation.
requirements.evidence: Device error queue and subsequent valid-query behavior.

blockers.reason: The upstream Linux simulator is a host application; an MCU-image backend is not yet qualified.
A separate plant observer must be qualified; querying the same SCPI implementation is insufficient.

limitations: The upstream simulator may support protocol diagnostics, but those do not establish MCU-binary reverse engineering.
Physical power output, overload protection and absolute calibration are not established in software.

mission.objective: Read axis state, change a bounded non-motion setting, preserve the other axis, and enter idle without commanding torque.

requirements.behavior: A bounded setting round-trips on the selected axis while the other axis remains unchanged.
requirements.evidence: Independent axis-state observer.

requirements.behavior: The selected axis enters idle and no torque-producing command is issued.
requirements.evidence: Independent state and output-enable observations.

requirements.behavior: Invalid state transitions are distinguishable from successful changes and allow a subsequent valid request.
requirements.evidence: Observed state before/after a refused transition.

blockers.reason: Motor, encoder and calibration dependencies need a qualified deterministic peripheral model.
blockers.evidence: Firmware board and axis startup dependencies.

blockers.reason: The proposed first mission can use UART ASCII; CAN coverage remains unsupported.
blockers.evidence: interface runtime transport inventory has no CAN binding.

blockers.reason: No independent axis-state and output-enable oracle is qualified yet.
blockers.evidence: Reading only the candidate's own decoded state would be circular.

limitations: This deliberately bounded configuration mission does not establish closed-loop motor control.
Different ODrive boards and interface versions share one origin group.

mission.objective: Read and write holding registers, switch individual coils, preserve unrelated state, and handle exception replies and bad CRCs.

requirements.behavior: Signedness/width and address selection preserve the requested 16-bit register values and unrelated registers.
requirements.evidence: Independent holding-register observer and disjoint read/write episodes.

requirements.behavior: A coil write changes exactly the selected GPIO output.
requirements.evidence: Independent GPIO output observation.

requirements.behavior: Invalid addresses do not claim success, change state or prevent the next valid operation.
requirements.evidence: Complete exception reply plus state and subsequent valid-operation checks.

requirements.behavior: A bad-CRC request cannot change device state or yield a successful data result.
requirements.evidence: Independent request corruption and GPIO/register observation.

limitations: The sample's holding registers are volatile; power-loss persistence is not claimed.
RTU over a loopback UART bridge does not establish RS-485 electrical behavior, TCP Modbus or CANopen.
